records.description: Fintelite is an AI-powered platform that automates document processing and verification. It extracts data, checks authenticity, and detects fraud using OCR and machine learning, processing documents up to 10x faster with over 90% accuracy, all in one place.

records.name: Shisa.AI
records.tagline: Open-source foundation for superior Japanese LLMs
records.description: Shisa.AI presents Japan's top open-source bilingual (JA/EN) LLM, Shisa V2 405B. Based on Llama 3.1 405B, it rivals GPT-4o & DeepSeek-V3 on Japanese tasks. Releases include the model, dataset, and a chat demo.

records.name: Noteify
records.tagline: Fast, Simple & Secure Cloud Notepad
records.description: Noteify is a simple, clean, and fast online notepad built for everyday use. Take notes instantly, organize them by date, and access your content from anywhere. Designed for speed and clarity, Noteify supports login, search and free cloud saving functions

records.name: Pop-Cam
records.tagline: Turn your selfies into illustrations

records.description: Transform your look with AI Haircut Simulator! Test new haircuts, match styles to your face shape, or explore trendy looks using AI. It's your virtual hairstyle assistant—fun, fast, and easy to visualize stunning styles in seconds.

records.name: Heygen AI Studio

records.name: Zentrade

records.description: Zentrade is a tool for crypto traders that helps preserve their capital. Currently, it's available for the Bybit exchange. The tool automatically blocks trades when conditions are risky, ensuring that your capital stays protected.

records.name: ImagesAI
